reports.work_area: East workshop, overhead corridor duct run
reports.work_planned: Install four rectangular duct sections above the east workshop corridor.
reports.work_completed: Four duct sections installed on accepted supports; all joints inspected and sealed to approved detail V-208 revision F.
reports.materials_equipment: Rectangular duct sections, joint sealant, access platform, hand tools
reports.issue_or_update: Routine installation completed. Supports were accepted under signed inspection VS-1001 before loading. Approved instruction TQ-088 was received before this work began.
reports.schedule_status: Work remains on the agreed sequence. Joint-sealant cure is scheduled through 2026-10-02 12:00.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: V-208 revision F; TQ-088 closed; VS-1001 accepted
reports.action_required: Maintain the posted cure barrier until the specified release time.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Four duct sections received and four installed; two sealant cartridges issued and two consumed
reports.supporting_evidence: Signed support inspection VS-1001, approved drawing, instruction receipt, and material log filed

reports.work_area: East workshop, overhead corridor duct run
reports.work_planned: Inspect completed duct joints after the specified sealant cure.
reports.work_completed: Cure barrier removed at 12:15 after the specified 12:00 release. Joint inspection and leakage test passed at 13:20. Signed acceptance VQ-1002 recorded and linked in the work package.
reports.materials_equipment: Rectangular duct sections, joint sealant, access platform, hand tools
reports.issue_or_update: All tested joints met the approved leakage criterion. The installation and quality inspection are accepted; no corrective items were raised.
reports.schedule_status: Controls handoff remains scheduled for 2026-10-05 08:00. The controls supervisor acknowledged the handoff notice at 14:05 today.
reports.action_required: Proceed with the agreed controls handoff on October 5.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Four installed sections tested and accepted; measured leakage within the specified limit
reports.supporting_evidence: Signed acceptance VQ-1002, test sheet LT-1002, and acknowledged handoff notice HN-1002 filed

reports.work_area: East workshop, corridor and controls cabinet zone
reports.work_planned: Complete housekeeping and confirm next-week access.
reports.work_completed: Housekeeping completed and corridor returned to normal use. Controls equipment staged in the designated cabinet zone outside the duct work area.
reports.materials_equipment: Rectangular duct sections, joint sealant, access platform, hand tools
reports.issue_or_update: Work package reviewed: support inspection, approved detail, leakage-test result, and signed completion acceptance are all linked and complete. No outstanding corrective work or technical query is listed.
reports.schedule_status: Controls handoff remains booked for October 5 at 08:00. Both trade supervisors confirmed the plan and access route.
reports.action_required: Follow the agreed October 5 handoff plan.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Four duct sections installed and accepted; store and installation totals balanced
reports.supporting_evidence: Closed work-package checklist WC-1003 and coordination acknowledgement CA-1003 filed
